verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents card authorization controls that set rules on how and where issued cards may be used, plus marketing for corporate-card spend controls and a spend product to 'control' company spend. That shows automatically enforced limits at the card level, but nothing shows budgets grouped by department or program. Missing for 10: department/program budget objects, enforcement of limits at the budget level rather than per card, budget tracking or reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
